name: Welcome!
summary: This errand directs arriving Horde adventurers carrying a distinctive voucher to seek out Magga in Razor Hill. In exchange for the token, she offers a rare traveling companion to walk alongside them on their travels across Kalimdor and beyond.

sections.title: A Special Delivery
sections.body: Newly arrived travelers stepping into Durotar with a gift voucher are pointed directly toward the central settlement of Razor Hill. Rather than sending recruits into battle against quillboars or centaur, this message directs them straight into the settlement's inn to meet Magga, an innkeeper eager to honor extraordinary commendations.

sections.title: A Companion on the Road
sections.body: Magga accepts the voucher with high praise, recognizing the bearer as a noteworthy traveler embarking on a long journey. In exchange, she provides a small creature to serve as a constant companion throughout the perilous trials awaiting Horde champions in the untamed wilderness.

faq.answer: The voucher marks an adventurer deemed exceptional upon their arrival. Delivering it to Magga in Razor Hill allows you to choose a small creature to accompany you on your travels across Azeroth.
Magga is an orc host located inside the bustling inn of Razor Hill in central Durotar. She welcomes travelers, manages lodgings, and honors special arrival vouchers.

faq.q: Where do I turn this in?
faq.answer: The voucher is brought to Razor Hill, the major Horde hub directly north of the Valley of Trials in Durotar. Magga waits inside the inn.

faq.q: Do Alliance players have an equivalent?
faq.answer: Yes, Alliance adventurers receive a similar voucher upon setting out, directing them to innkeepers in their own settlements, such as Goldshire, Kharanos, or Dolanaar.

angles.text: Horde adventurers receive this warm welcome upon passing through Razor Hill, establishing an early bond with the central outpost of Durotar.
